cases.title: One role each — grounded in your materials.

case.1.title: AI Tutor
case.1.desc: Hand over your textbooks, lecture notes and slides: a student asks 'how do I solve this?' and it walks through the material step by step; a teacher needs a quiz and it drafts one from the syllabus — ready whenever the service is online.
case.2.title: Onboarding Mentor
case.2.desc: Hand over your employee handbook, SOPs and training docs: new hires ask 'how do I file expenses?' or 'how do I kick off a project?' and it answers from policy quickly — so senior staff stop being walking manuals.
case.3.title: Personal Assistant
case.3.desc: Hand over your scattered reading notes, reports and excerpts: mid-proposal, if you forget a report's key conclusion, just ask and it brings up the conclusion and context.
case.4.title: Domain Consultant
case.4.desc: Hand over your industry standards, policies and case files: clients ask 'how do I apply for this license?' or 'how does the new rule affect us?' and it explains point by point from your materials, ready for your team or clients to ask directly.

deploy.title: Self-host and keep your data and compute under your own control.
deploy.desc: Self-host with a single npm package. Below are the setup steps (with an admin CLI reference), the root credentials and API/model/WeChat Pay/SMS configuration needed to activate the modules, and the complete set of feature modules included.
deploy.m1.title: No-code AI Agent / Skill builder
deploy.m1.desc: Upload one document to generate an Agent, or describe it in a sentence to generate a Skill — no prompt engineering, no vector database, ready in about 3 minutes.
deploy.m2.title: Workflow engine
deploy.m2.desc: Visually arrange multiple Skills into a single workflow, with node-level rollback, pause, and human intervention (Human-in-the-Loop). Build once, reuse endlessly.
deploy.m3.title: Multi-model collaboration
deploy.m3.desc: Different language models can be orchestrated into the same workflow through different Skills, each doing its part and handing off to complete multi-step tasks.
deploy.m4.title: AI compute / model access
deploy.m4.desc: One adapter for DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, Moonshot, Volcano Engine and more, plus image and speech providers. Custom models and BYO-Key are supported, with separate defaults for text, image generation, and image input (vision).
deploy.m5.title: User accounts
deploy.m5.desc: Once SMS is configured: SMS-code login / sign-up, account and permission management, sessions and rate limiting, API Key management. Sign in to see your Agent / Skill and usage details.
deploy.m6.title: Credits (WeChat Pay)
deploy.m6.desc: Credit balance plus spending and income records at a glance; WeChat Pay APIv2 order parameters can be configured, while callback verification and crediting need to be implemented for your deployment. Pay-as-you-go, zero cost when idle.
deploy.activate.title: Activate AI modules
deploy.steps.title: Setup steps
deploy.steps.caption: Self-hosted package (transweb-service)
deploy.reference.title: Admin commands (reference)
deploy.reference.caption: CLI reference for after setup; collapsed by default
deploy.activate.caption: Configure the items below in priority order; click a title to expand its overview and instructions.
deploy.activate.root.label: root admin
deploy.activate.root.overview: Highest priority: get the admin login credentials first, then configure compute, payments, and login SMS.
deploy.activate.root.desc: transweb root accessKey prints the root admin account and universal verification code; defaults are transweb / transweb$harness. Choose code login and enter the universal code.
deploy.activate.api.label: Compute provider
deploy.activate.api.overview: One compute provider maps to one apiName; configure at least one.
deploy.activate.api.desc: apiName is the custom provider name (for example dmxapi or a vendor name); models reference it with --api-name. --key is written to .env as API_KEY_*; common.js keeps only a reference.
deploy.activate.model.label: model
deploy.activate.model.overview: Models belong to a compute provider; configure at least one and set a default.
deploy.activate.model.desc: At least one, with apiName, rates, and from. A rate is the credits-to-token ratio: how many credits one AI token costs, with separate input/output rates. from is domestic or overseas; context is the context window size. After configuring, run transweb default model to set it as the default.
deploy.activate.pay.label: WeChat Pay
deploy.activate.pay.overview: Configure WeChat Pay APIv2 before accepting payments; complete the required fields.
deploy.activate.pay.desc: Required: WX_PAY_APP_ID, WX_PAY_MCH_ID, WX_PAY_APP_KEY (32-char APIv2 key), WX_PAY_ORDER_URL, WX_PAY_QUERY_URL. Optional: WX_PAY_APP_SECRET, WX_PAY_NOTIFY, WX_PAY_APP_ID001 / SECRET001. Set with transweb wxpay set and verify with transweb wxpay check. The install-generated APP_KEY is random; replace it with your merchant APIv2 key before taking payments.
deploy.activate.sms.label: Login SMS
deploy.activate.sms.overview: SMS verification for login / sign-up; phone-code login is unavailable until configured.
deploy.activate.sms.desc: SMS verification API key for login / sign-up: SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY (Luosimao). Set it with transweb env set SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY <key>; without it, phone-code login and registration are unavailable.
deploy.activate.hint: Expand each item for commands; check AI config with transweb api list, transweb model list, and transweb default list, WeChat Pay with transweb wxpay check, and SMS with transweb env get SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY. Add --force to overwrite existing API/model entries. transweb root accessKey and transweb env get read the same .env values for ADMIN_ACCOUNT / POWER_ADMIN; run transweb restart after changing them.
faq.title: FAQ
faq.desc: Answers to the most common questions about how to create one, how to hand it to others, move it between services, data security, and pricing.
faq.q1: How long does it take to create a digital employee?
faq.a1: From upload to first question usually takes under 3 minutes: parsing, knowledge structuring, and building your digital employee happen automatically — no prompt or workflow setup. Longer documents take slightly longer, with progress shown in real time.
faq.q2: Which file formats are supported? Is there a size limit?
faq.a2: PDF, Word (.doc / .docx), Markdown, and plain text (.txt) are supported. We recommend keeping a single document under 20 MB; for very large documents, split by chapter for more focused answers.
faq.q3: Will my documents be used to train models?
faq.a3.1: No. Your documents are used only to build your own digital employee. When served over HTTPS, they are encrypted in transit and isolated per account. We do not use them to train public models, and other users cannot retrieve them. You can delete them at any time, which invalidates the parsed results. See our
faq.a4: Credits are based on the tokens actually consumed by model calls; publishing/exporting and similar actions may charge a one-off service fee as configured. No subscription or prepaid plans, zero cost when idle; the page and actual usage are the source of truth.
faq.q5: What if an answer isn't accurate?
faq.a5.1: This usually means the material lacks the relevant content or is too scattered. Add or replace the source and regenerate; including chapter names or technical terms in your question also helps. If the issue persists, feel free to
faq.a5.2: with your document type and a sample question.
faq.q6: Can I hand my digital employee to students, colleagues, or clients?
faq.a6: Yes. Generate a shareable link or embed it in a webpage to hand your digital employee to students, colleagues, or clients — they use points from their own account, so you don't answer the same questions again.
faq.q7: What if I'm not happy with the result — can I adjust it?
faq.a7: Yes. Add, replace, or remove source materials and regenerate — no need to start from scratch.
faq.q8: How do I move a digital employee or AI skill to another TransWeb service?
faq.a8: You can move the definition, not the account data. In the source service, open the Agent / Skill editor and choose Download from the action menu to get a zip with appCode.vue, appPrompt.md, manifest.json, and related files. In the target service, sign in, open the AI Skill Generator (skill.html), click Clone at the bottom right of the input, choose Chat Agent or AI Skill, then Local file clone and select appCode.vue (appPrompt.md optional). If the source is publicly reachable, Online URL clone with the manifest.json URL also works. Cross-account moves must be exported by the owner and sent to you; the target service needs a working API and model first.
faq.q9: Do the original documents, chats, credits, and share links move too?
faq.a9: No. Only the Agent / Skill definition files (interface code, prompt, and manifest) travel in the package. Original documents, parsed knowledge, chat history, credits, accounts, and published links stay with the source service. On the target service, re-upload the documents, rebuild the knowledge base, choose a model, and publish again to get a new share link and QR code. Switching accounts within the same service works the same way: data and credits remain separate.

legal.contact.title: Contact Us
privacy.s1.title: What we collect
privacy.s1.text: Account identifiers (login method and nickname), documents you upload, and operational logs necessary to keep the service running — such as access times, device and browser types, and error information. We do not track your browsing for advertising, and we never use this information for purposes beyond those described here.
privacy.s2.title: How your documents are used
privacy.s2.text: Your documents are used only to build and support your own digital employee. Parsed results are visible only within your account and are used to answer your questions. We do not use them to train public models and never sell them. To complete each request, the minimum necessary content is shared with model/cloud providers (see Third-party services).
privacy.s3.title: Storage & security
privacy.s3.text: When accessed over HTTPS, documents are encrypted in transit with TLS; at rest, they are isolated per account with access controls. Operational logs are retained only as long as needed for troubleshooting and are purged automatically.
privacy.s4.title: Third-party services
privacy.s4.text: Parsing and Q&A rely on underlying model and cloud infrastructure providers. We share only the minimum content required to complete each request and require them to uphold equivalent confidentiality.
privacy.s5.title: Your choices
privacy.s5.text: You can view, export, or delete your documents and digital employees at any time. Deletion also clears the corresponding parsed results and generated records. To close your account, contact us and we'll process it after verifying your identity.
privacy.s6.title: Minors
privacy.s6.text: This service is intended for users with full civil capacity. If you are under 18, please read this policy and use the service under a guardian's supervision.
privacy.s7.title: Policy updates
privacy.s7.text: If this policy changes materially, we'll post a notice in a prominent place and update the date above. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
terms.s1.title: Service description
terms.s1.text: This service turns the documents you provide into a conversational AI Agent (digital employee) and provides access and billing capabilities. Results are generated automatically by models — please verify accuracy against your source material.
terms.s2.title: Account & responsibility
terms.s2.text: Keep your account credentials secure; actions under your account are treated as your own. If you notice unusual activity, contact us immediately.
terms.s3.title: Your content
terms.s3.text: You retain all rights to the documents you upload. You also confirm you have lawful rights to use them, and that they do not infringe others' intellectual property, privacy, or other legal rights, nor contain unlawful content.
terms.s4.title: Acceptable use
terms.s4.text: You may not use the service to generate unlawful content, commit fraud, circumvent usage limits, reverse-engineer or stress-test the service, or interfere with its normal operation.
terms.s5.title: Billing & refunds
terms.s5.text: Fees are based on the credits actually consumed by model calls, plus any one-off service fees for publishing or exporting as configured; the page and actual usage are the source of truth. If the service is unavailable due to our own fault, you may request a corresponding refund.
terms.s6.title: Changes & termination
terms.s6.text: We may adjust, suspend, or terminate features, with advance notice for material changes. If you disagree, you may stop using the service and delete your data.
terms.s7.title: Disclaimer
terms.s7.text: The service is provided "as is." AI output does not constitute legal, medical, financial, or other professional advice; consult qualified professionals for such matters.
terms.s8.title: Governing law
terms.s8.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. In case of dispute, the parties shall first attempt amicable resolution.
